description:
Scout, search, adopt, and update spells from external sources.

Use when: When discovering new skills from AgentSkillHub or GitHub, importing them, or checking for upstream updates.
Not for: When working with local spells only — use inscribe_spell or hone_spell.

inputSchema.description: Scout, search, adopt, and update spells from external sources.

action.description: Scout action to perform: adopt (import from source), search (find skills), check_updates, or apply_update.

chapter.description: Chapter for adopted spells — optional for adopt.

source.description: Source URL or identifier — required for adopt.

name: scout_skills
